_how: The words and numbers of the workbench page. Edit this file, then run: node hub/build.mjs && node hub/check.mjs
Every line is meant to be read in a glance: keep bullets under about 12 words.
steps[].state is done, running or next. pictures[].src is a path from the portage folder, or a path inside the site (shots/...).
title: Portage
subtitle: The workbench: every step so far
ask: A flooded world and all you have is a canoe. Scavenge islands, craft, and build a crazy impressive canoe.

steps.title: Why it was choppy

Second fault: the 60 cap was wrong on 75, 90 and 144 Hz screens
Ruled out: processor, triangles, shadows, memory
snags: Your friend's real computer is still unknown

proof: 4 times slower: 60 fps from 1.8 s. It was 50, after 47 s

snags: 8 times slower: the review measured 44 fps, not the 59 reported
